name: undoable-action
title: Undoable Action
description: A delete that mutates in place through three real, timed levels of permanence: an instant Undo (fast draining bar), a quieter Recently Deleted holding pen with its own restore window (dashed border, slower drain), then a locked, grayscale, button-less permanently deleted state. Both countdowns are driven by real elapsed time, not a guessed CSS duration.
